get.summary: Search the WiGLE Bluetooth database.
get.description:
Query the WiGLE database for paginated results based on multiple criteria. API and session authentication default to a page size of 100 results/page. COMMAPI defaults to a page size of 25 with a maximum of 1000 results per return. Number of daily queries allowed per user are throttled based on history and participation. Search endpoints are the only feature included in COMMAPI subscriptions at this time.

To get next page of results put the previous request's searchAfter value as a parameter in the new request's searchAfter.

parameters.name: onlymine
parameters.description: Search only for points first discovered by the current user. Use any string to set, leave unset for general search. Can't be used with COMMAPI auth, since these are points you have locally.

parameters.name: notmine
parameters.description: Only search for networks first seen by other users

parameters.name: latrange1
parameters.description: Lesser of two latitudes by which to bound the search (specify both)

parameters.name: latrange2
parameters.description: Greater of two latitudes by which to bound the search (specify both)

parameters.name: longrange1
parameters.description: Lesser of two longitudes by which to bound the search (specify both)

parameters.name: longrange2
parameters.description: Greater of two longitudes by which to bound the search (specify both)

parameters.name: closestLat
parameters.description: Latitude to order by closest network (requires closestLong)

parameters.name: closestLong
parameters.description: Longitude to order by closest network (requires closestLat)

parameters.name: lastupdt
parameters.description: Filter points by how recently they've been updated (more recent than this value), condensed date/time numeric string format 'yyyyMMdd[hhmm[ss]]'

parameters.name: firsttime
parameters.description: Filter points by when they were first created (more recent than this value), condensed date/time numeric string format 'yyyyMMdd[hhmm[ss]]'

parameters.name: lasttime
parameters.description: Filter points by how recently they've had data submitted (more recent than this value), condensed date/time numeric string format 'yyyyMMdd[hhmm[ss]]'

parameters.name: startTransID
parameters.description: Earliest transid by which to bound (year-level precision only), format 'yyyyMMdd-00000'

parameters.name: endTransID
parameters.description: Latest transid by which to bound (year-level precision only), format 'yyyyMMdd-00000'

parameters.name: netid
parameters.description: Include only networks matching the string network BSSID, e.g. '0A:2C:EF:3D:25:1B' or '0A:2C:EF'. The first three octets are required.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Include only networks exactly matching the string network name.

parameters.name: namelike
parameters.description: Include only networks matching the string network name, allowing wildcards '%' (any string) and '_' (any character).

parameters.name: showBt
parameters.description: Include BT networks

parameters.name: showBle
parameters.description: Include BLE networks

parameters.name: minQoS
parameters.description: Minimum Quality of Signal (0-7).

parameters.name: variance
parameters.description: How tightly to bound queries against the provided latitude/longitude box. Value must be between 0.001 and 0.2. Intended for use with non-exact decimals and geocoded bounds.

parameters.name: mfgrIdMinimum
parameters.description: The minimum Manufacturer Identifier, inclusive

parameters.name: mfgrIdMaximum
parameters.description: The maximum Manufacturer Identifier, inclusive

parameters.name: houseNumber
parameters.description: Street address house number

parameters.name: road
parameters.description: Street address road

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: Street address city

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Street address region

parameters.name: postalCode
parameters.description: Street address postal code

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Street address country

parameters.name: resultsPerPage
parameters.description: How many results to return per request. Defaults to 25 for COMMAPI, 100 for site. Bounded at 1000 for COMMAPI, 100 for site.

parameters.name: searchAfter
parameters.description: Put in the previous page's searchAfter result to get the next page. Use this instead of 'first'

get.summary: Request list of channels for GSM, LTE, WCDMA, or 5G NR transmitters in specified region
get.description: List of known channels and QoS values for any of the non-CDMA cell types in a bounding box. Note that the type parameter is sensitive to current type in the WiGLE database - this means that LTE and WCDMA networks may have been reported as GSM in some packages, a fallback query to GSM is recommended if the LTE/WCDMA network appears to be absent. Channel endpoints are NOT included in COMMAPI subscriptions at this time. Region cannot be large than 99 square miles (~256 sq km). Daily query limit subject to user DETAIL limit. Designed to support cell-site simulator detection.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Network Type: GSM/LTE/WCDMA/5G NR

parameters.name: latitude1
parameters.description: First bounding latitude

parameters.name: latitude2
parameters.description: Second bounding latitude

parameters.name: longitude1
parameters.description: First bounding longitude

parameters.name: longitude2
parameters.description: Second bounding longitude

parameters.name: closestLat
parameters.description: Latitude to order by closest network (requires closestLong)

parameters.name: closestLong
parameters.description: Longitude to order by closest network (requires closestLat)

404.description: No matching cell sites found in region.

500.description: Failed to retrieve due to error.

tags: Network observation file upload and status.
post.description: Transmit a file for processing and incorporation into the database. Supports DStumbler, G-Mon, inSSIDer, Kismac, Kismet, MacStumbler, NetStumbler, Pocket Warrior, Wardrive-Android, WiFiFoFum, WiFi-Where, WiGLE WiFi Wardriving, and Apple consolidated DB formats. One or more files may be enclosed within a zip, tar, or tar.gz archive. Files may not exceed 180MiB, and archives WILL IGNORE more than 200 member files. For documentation on WiGLE Wireless CSV files, see https://api.wigle.net/csvFormat.html

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: multipart/form-data file; proper formulation requires both filename and payload.

parameters.name: donate
parameters.description: Allow commercial use of the file contents - 'on' to allow.
